issues.description: Reports describe access failures, including inability to log in or install, error messages, and lost saved music.
Users report being unable to log in to an existing account, often encountering repeated errors.
Users report unwanted playlist additions and limited song selection or playback controls, alongside complaints about ads and shuffle behavior.
Reviews broadly criticize updates and missing features, with a few distinct reports of glitches, ads, or unavailable history deletion.
Users report ads appearing too frequently during music or podcast listening.
